Hello Joy Events & Catering team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for caterers in Chennai. I was looking at joycaterer.com this week. Your site already works well on a phone: the price-lock offer, your 25 to 5,000-guest range and the WhatsApp button are all right there on the first screen.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:

See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/joy-caterer/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. It opens on your banana-leaf wedding feast, then your buffet, cut-fruit counter and floral stage fill the screen one by one as they scroll, before your numbers, your founders' story and a check-your-date button.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a caterer in Ambattur”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now joycaterer.com has a few of the basics, but not the full set these tools look for. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

What you get for ₹25,000 (one-time)

  • Works smoothly on phones and computers
  • Ready for AI search: your menus, guest range, service areas and the price lock and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you
  • A “check if you're free to cater on my date” button that sends the function date straight to your WhatsApp
  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so families planning functions searching for caterers in Ambattur can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days

  • Day 1: a quick call, and we start
  • Days 2–3: you send any new photos or changes
  • Day 5: you see the updated version
  • Day 7: it goes live on joycaterer.com
